name: Studio Video
description: Videos from text timelines: YAML with clips one after another (video files, pictures with zoom and pan, title cards, computed clips — and stick scenes, pictures and songs made by the other Studio tools, rendered automatically), transitions, text/picture overlays, subtitles (+ .srt) and a mixed soundtrack with ducking, rendered to MP4/GIF/WebM with a contact sheet to look at. Trailers, slideshows, shorts, explainers, music videos. Also inspects any media file (length, size, a contact sheet of its frames). Extensible with Python plugins (transitions, generators).

commands.description: the timeline as a table: what is shown and heard when
